description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class called PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException, used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that placeholder functions have become too complex to process safely. It includes methods for constructing, serializing, and deserializing the exception, as well as linking to related exception classes and metadata.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when placeholder functions exceed allowed complexity, extends DittoRuntimeException, includes methods for creation, serialization, and deserialization.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class providing a mutable builder with a fluent API to construct instances of PlaceholderFunctionTooComplexException, marked as not thread-safe.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the exception with a default message, accepting the maximum allowed chained functions as parameter.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the exception from a JSON object and associated headers.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder for the current exception instance, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.
